name: Amoxicillin
summary: An antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. It does not treat viral colds or flu.
caution: Tell your pharmacist or prescriber about any previous penicillin allergy before taking it.

name: Azithromycin
summary: A macrolide antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. A clinician must decide whether it is appropriate.
caution: Ask a pharmacist about interactions with other medicines and any health conditions before taking it.

name: Metronidazole
summary: Used for certain bacterial and parasitic infections. Its presence on a package does not establish what illness you have.
caution: Avoid alcohol while taking oral metronidazole; ask your pharmacist how long to wait after finishing.

name: Doxycycline
summary: An antibiotic for certain infections and other clinician-directed purposes. Recognition does not establish suitability.
caution: Discuss other medicines, pregnancy or breastfeeding with a pharmacist or prescriber before using it.

name: Ciprofloxacin
summary: An antibiotic for certain infections. It is often used only when other antibiotic options have not worked or are unsuitable.
caution: It can cause rare but serious, sometimes lasting side effects. Discuss the risks with your prescriber.

name: Flucloxacillin
summary: A penicillin antibiotic used for some bacterial infections, including skin and wound infections.
caution: Ask a pharmacist or prescriber about allergies, interactions and your own prescription.

name: Cefalexin
summary: A cephalosporin antibiotic for certain bacterial infections. A professional assessment determines whether it is needed.
caution: Ask a pharmacist about other medicines and supplements before using cefalexin.

name: Nitrofurantoin
summary: An antibiotic used for certain urinary tract infections. It is not a general treatment for every infection.
caution: Speak with a pharmacist or prescriber about health conditions and your own prescription.

name: Clarithromycin
summary: A macrolide antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections, sometimes together with other prescribed medicines.
caution: Ask a pharmacist or prescriber to check interactions with your other medicines.

name: Co-amoxiclav
summary: A combination medicine containing amoxicillin and clavulanic acid. It is a distinct record, not an amoxicillin-only product.
caution: Both active ingredients must match the label. Ask a pharmacist about penicillin allergy and suitability.

name: Paracetamol
summary: A medicine for pain and high temperature. It is not an antibiotic and does not treat a bacterial infection itself.
caution: Check for paracetamol in other medicines too. Ask a pharmacist about safe use; this app does not provide doses.

name: Ibuprofen
summary: A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine for pain, inflammation and fever. It is not an antibiotic.
caution: Ibuprofen is not suitable for everyone. Ask a pharmacist about health conditions, other medicines and safe use.

name: Trimethoprim
summary: An antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections, including some urinary tract infections. A professional decides whether it is appropriate.
caution: Ask a pharmacist or prescriber to check other medicines and health conditions before use.

name: Phenoxymethylpenicillin
summary: A prescription antibiotic for certain bacterial infections. Label recognition does not establish a need for treatment.
caution: Discuss previous penicillin allergy and your own prescription with a pharmacist or prescriber.

name: Erythromycin
summary: A prescription antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. It is not a treatment recommendation for symptoms entered in this app.
caution: Ask a pharmacist to check interactions and whether it is suitable for your health conditions.

name: Co-trimoxazole
summary: A combination of sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim for certain bacterial infections. Both active ingredients belong to this record.
caution: Confirm both active ingredients. Discuss allergies, other medicines and personal suitability with a pharmacist or prescriber.
